name: Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2022, Dhampur Bio Organics Ltd manufactures sugar, chemicals, ethanol, 
co-generation of power and other allied products[1]
keyPoints:
Busienss Overview:[1][2]
DBOL is an integrated sugarcane processing company with a growing presence in agri-business and bioenergy. It manufactures refined and raw sugar, bio-fuels, biomass-based renewable power, and other related products.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.51 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 37.7%
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.55% over last 3 years.
